concept.hr: Slow start, congestion avoidance i AIMD pila; Reno i CUBIC nakon gubitka
concept.en: Slow start, congestion avoidance, the AIMD sawtooth; Reno and CUBIC after a loss

summary.hr: Zadaj RTT, kapacitet i gubitke i gledaj cwnd kroz 60 RTT-ova: udvostručenje, +1 po RTT-u, pad na pola ili na 1, CUBIC-ov rast u sekundama.
summary.en: Set the RTT, capacity and losses and watch cwnd over 60 RTTs: doubling, +1 per RTT, halving or back to 1, CUBIC growing in seconds.
